name: Wheelbase Partner API
description:
External-facing partner API for Wheelbase. Stable contract; internal services churn freely behind a translation layer.

## Authentication
All `/v1/*` and `/mcp` endpoints require a bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens are issued per credential and carry scopes; a missing scope returns `403`.

## Rate limits
Fixed wall-clock window of 500 requests/minute per credential. Every response carries `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, and `X-RateLimit-Reset` (the Unix epoch second at which the window resets). A `429` includes `Retry-After` (seconds).

## Errors
Errors return `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`. Beyond each operation's documented responses, these can occur on any endpoint: `401` (missing/invalid token), `403` (missing scope / not dealer-scoped), `422`/`400` (validation), `429` (rate limited), and `5xx` (upstream unavailable). Treat `429` and `5xx` as retryable with backoff; `401`/`403`/`422` are not.

## Result ordering
List and report endpoints return newest-first (creation date descending) unless noted. Because new rows insert at the front, a report paged while data is being written can re-deliver a row on a later page — dedupe by `id`.
